title: KBA ECE R124 approval 000086 - Otto Fuchs wheel type 37026 (9 J x 17 H2 ET55)
publisher: Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt (KBA); published by Otto Fuchs KG
notes: ECE Regulation No. 124 communication issued by the Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt (E1, approval number 000086, dated 13.02.2013) for the Otto Fuchs KG forged aluminium wheel type 37026, published on the Fuchs website together with the TUV NORD test report and its application annex. Downloaded and read as text on 2026-10-15; no copy is kept in the repository. The wheel data state rim contour 9 J x 17 H2, inset ET 55 mm, 5 holes on a 130 mm pitch circle, 15 mm bolt holes, centre bore 71.58 mm with centre centring, tested wheel load 625 kg. The application annex for Porsche lists Porsche 911 Carrera (type 993) rear axle with 255/40ZR17 and 993 Turbo rear axle; front partner 37024 (7 J x 17 ET55); the vehicle-side column for these rows reads 5/130/71,5, the hub pattern and centring diameter of the vehicle, which is not the wheel centre bore. Inline component citation: COMP-FUCHS-37026.013 (catalog/components). A type approval states approved fitment and declared wheel data; it gives no wheel profile, seat geometry or tolerance and is not a manufacturing drawing. Wheels are a safety class: nothing here allows a wheel to be made or released. The 71.58 mm versus 71.5 mm attribution is tracked in catalog/registers/contradictions.json.
